notes: Tansy Pell, twelve (bible 5.5), clever, reads everything she is not supposed to. Only talkable once tansy.saved (the entry `asleep` is the guard for a sleepwalking Tansy). Not placed in a town scene yet: until Vespers she is in the Fold, and scenes have no fact-gated presence, so the creature is unplaced and this dialogue is data-ready. Bible 4.1 beat 14: after the bell she asks who you are.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Tansy hums a tune with no words in it. Her eyes are open and she does not see you.

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: Who are you? You rang the bell, didn't you. I heard it from a very long way down. It sounded wrong. And then it sounded like somebody had finally said sorry.

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: Oh, you. I'm not supposed to be out. Da's said so twice. I told him I'm only as far as the Stacks, which is true if you squint.

options.text: What do you remember of the dark?
Have you ever heard of a Brother Anselm Hobb?

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: A soft room. Everyone breathing slowly, in time. And somebody big humming over us, and then a blanket, and then bread. Goblin bread. Da says goblins don't bake. They do. It was stale, which means somebody made it.

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: He was careful of my head. Very careful. His hands were bigger than the oven door. Please don't let them hurt him. He smelled like a barn, but a clean one.

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: He was careful of my head. Very careful. They told me he's, they told me. I don't think he meant to scare me. I think he'd had a very long time to practise being gentle.

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: The Ox Beneath the Hill. Mirela says it's for little ones. It isn't. It's a map, with the road left out. I've nearly worked out where the road goes, and then Da says it's bedtime.

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: Great-great-gran's brother? There's a letter in Da's Bible I'm not allowed to touch. I've read it twice. He talks about pears a lot. It's a very sad letter about pears.

nodes.speaker: tansy
nodes.text: Tell Da I'm only in the Stacks. And thank you. I don't know yet for what. I'll work it out.
